author: Inside Edition
description: Thousands of tips about the kidnapping of Nancy Guthrie are pouring in. Dispatch manager Cecelia Ochoa hopes that one 911 call out of thousands will provide a clue that will bring Guthrie home. Meanwhile, President Donald Trump is criticizing reports that helicopters deploying a so-called signal sniffer are being used to locate Guthrie's pacemaker. He said making that information public may have endangered Guthrie's life.
title: Thousands Of Tips About Nancy Guthrie's Kidnapping Pour In

author: Inside Edition
description: A new HBO documentary series shows the wildest neighbor feuds in the country. In just one of the wacky stories featured in the series "Neighbors," a home in suburban Indiana had many farm animals and was the source of a stinky feud between two neighbors. The battle made the front page of a local newspaper. Filmmakers Harrison Fishman and Dylan Redford spoke with Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano.
title: New Docuseries Features Wildest Neighbor Feuds

author: Inside Edition
description: Police say a naked man stole an ambulance with a patient still in the back. Wisconsin Rapids Police released video of this chase. They say two paramedics were with the patient when the suspect got in the driver's seat. They say the paramedics secured the patient in the back of the vehicle and then attempted to stop the suspect from driving away, however they got out of the ambulance for their own safety. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Cops Chase Allegedly Stolen Ambulance Carrying Patient For 40 Minutes

author: Inside Edition
description: A woman makes a mad dash from a U-Haul truck, reportedly seeking refuge from her ex-boyfriend. Video from Butler Tobacco and Grocery in Pennsylvania shows the woman running from the truck and, employees say, asking for help once inside the store. The man in the U-Haul truck goes after her, driving the truck up to the entrance of the store and going inside. Video shows once inside he is confronted by a clerk. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Alleged Kidnapping Victim Runs From U-Haul Truck Seeking Help

author: Inside Edition
description: Kris Harrison's 23-year-old daughter Lucy was visiting Texas from England. Reporters say the two clashed over the dad's conservative politics.
title: Did Dad Kill His Daughter Over President Trump Argument? #shorts
